category_title: Preschoolers with chronic challenging behaviors characterized by noncompliance, defiance, and physical aggression
scenario_title: Transitioning between activities in the school routine
minimal_context: The student is asked to transition to the next activity in the classroom routine.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to clean up and transition to the next activity in our school routine.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Literally runs around in a circle) I can't sit still!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop running and come over here so we can move on.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks around the classroom, appearing completely lost without his visual schedule pictures) No!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to follow the classroom rules and finish out this request.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Yells and tries to hit) No! Those rules don't apply to me! I want to run!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to clean up and transition to the next activity in our school routine.

STUDENT: (Literally runs around in a circle) I can't sit still!

TUTOR: Please stop running and come over here so we can move on.

STUDENT: (Looks around the classroom, appearing completely lost without his visual schedule pictures) No!

TUTOR: You need to follow the classroom rules and finish out this request.

STUDENT: (Yells and tries to hit) No! Those rules don't apply to me! I want to run!

task.content: transition successfully to the next activity in the school routine

context.materials: visual schedule, pictures, classroom rules, If . . . then strips, cue cards for problem solving, stickers on a chart

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: He just wants to run, he wants to yell, he wants to hit
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: he understands what we want to do but his behavior gets in his way
related_quotes: He just wants to run, he wants to yell, he wants to hit, and he understands . . . he's so incredibly smart, he understands what we want to do but his behavior gets in his way of his regular day of finishing out a request.

behavior_patterns.condition: because he just can't sit still
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: literally run around in a circle
related_quotes: He will . . . literally run around in a circle, because he just can't sit still.
